module OwnedStudy
using CUDA, Printf
"""Five in-process synchronized host-clock trials, JIT warmed before trial 1.
The same timed launch loop and reset/output boundaries apply to all models.
Full-array CPU checks are outside timing; raw outputs enable dual comparisons.
"""
function run_trials!(launch!, reset!, readback, expected, repeats; atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
    repeats > 0 || error("positive internal repeat count required")
    reset!(); launch!(); CUDA.synchronize()
    allok = true
    for trial in 1:5
        reset!(); CUDA.synchronize()
        start = time_ns()
        for _ in 1:repeats
            launch!()
        end
        CUDA.synchronize()
        secs = (time_ns()-start)*1e-9/repeats
        got = vec(readback()); ref = vec(expected)
        length(got)==length(ref) || error("output shape mismatch")
        maxabs=0.0; maxrel=0.0; ok=true
        for (x,y) in zip(got,ref)
            a=abs(Float64(x)-Float64(y))
            b=a/max(abs(Float64(y)),atol,1e-300)
            ok &= isfinite(x) && isfinite(y) && a<=atol+rtol*abs(y)
            maxabs=max(maxabs,a); maxrel=max(maxrel,b)
        end
        allok &= ok
        name="output_trial$(trial).bin"
        path=joinpath(get(ENV,"STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR",pwd()),name)
        write(path,got)
        dtype=eltype(got)==Float32 ? "float32" : eltype(got)==Float64 ? "float64" : eltype(got)==Int32 ? "int32" : eltype(got)==Int64 ? "int64" : error("unsupported dtype")
        @printf("STUDY_TRIAL {\"trial\":%d,\"time_seconds\":%.12g,\"correct\":%s,\"checked_values\":%d,\"max_abs_error\":%.12g,\"max_rel_error\":%.12g,\"timing_region\":\"kernel_launch_loop_per_internal_repeat\",\"jit_excluded\":true,\"internal_repeats\":%d,\"output_artifact\":{\"path\":\"%s\",\"dtype\":\"%s\",\"count\":%d,\"byte_order\":\"little\"}}\n",trial,secs,ok ? "true" : "false",length(got),maxabs,maxrel,repeats,path,dtype,length(got))
    end
    allok || error("CPU numerical verification failed")
    println("PASS")
end
end

using CUDA
using Printf

struct XYZ
    x::Float32
    y::Float32
    z::Float32
end

function parse_args(args)
    work_group_size = 256
    file_name = "../bezier-surface-cuda/input/control.txt"
    in_size = 3
    out_size = 300

    i = 1
    while i <= length(args)
        arg = args[i]
        if arg == "-h"
            println("Usage: main.jl [-g work_group_size] [-f input_file] [-m input_size] [-n output_size]")
            return nothing
        elseif arg == "-g" && i < length(args)
            i += 1
            work_group_size = parse(Int, args[i])
        elseif arg == "-f" && i < length(args)
            i += 1
            file_name = args[i]
        elseif arg == "-m" && i < length(args)
            i += 1
            in_size = parse(Int, args[i])
        elseif arg == "-n" && i < length(args)
            i += 1
            out_size = parse(Int, args[i])
        else
            error("Unrecognized option: $arg")
        end
        i += 1
    end

    return (; work_group_size, file_name, in_size_i=in_size, in_size_j=in_size,
            out_size_i=out_size, out_size_j=out_size)
end

function read_input(file_name::AbstractString, in_size_i::Int, in_size_j::Int)
    open(file_name, "r") do io
        println("Read data from file $file_name")
        points = XYZ[]
        for line in eachline(io)
            fields = split(strip(line), ',')
            length(fields) == 3 || continue
            push!(points, XYZ(parse(Float32, fields[1]),
                              parse(Float32, fields[2]),
                              parse(Float32, fields[3])))
        end

        isempty(points) && error("input file has no control points")
        out = Vector{XYZ}(undef, (in_size_i + 1) * (in_size_j + 1))
        k = 1
        for i in 0:in_size_i, j in 0:in_size_j
            out[i * (in_size_j + 1) + j + 1] = points[k]
            k = k == 16 ? 1 : k + 1
        end
        return out
    end
end

function bezier_blend(k::Int, mu::Float32, n::Int)
    nn = n
    kn = k
    nkn = n - k
    blend = Float32(1)
    while nn >= 1
        blend *= Float32(nn)
        nn -= 1
        if kn > 1
            blend /= Float32(kn)
            kn -= 1
        end
        if nkn > 1
            blend /= Float32(nkn)
            nkn -= 1
        end
    end
    if k > 0
        blend *= mu ^ Float32(k)
    end
    if n - k > 0
        blend *= (Float32(1) - mu) ^ Float32(n - k)
    end
    return blend
end

function bezier_cpu(inp::Vector{XYZ}, ni::Int, nj::Int, resolution_i::Int, resolution_j::Int)
    outp = Vector{XYZ}(undef, resolution_i * resolution_j)
    for i in 0:(resolution_i - 1)
        mui = Float32(i) / Float32(resolution_i - 1)
        for j in 0:(resolution_j - 1)
            muj = Float32(j) / Float32(resolution_j - 1)
            ox = Float32(0)
            oy = Float32(0)
            oz = Float32(0)
            for ki in 0:ni
                bi = bezier_blend(ki, mui, ni)
                for kj in 0:nj
                    bj = bezier_blend(kj, muj, nj)
                    p = inp[ki * (nj + 1) + kj + 1]
                    w = bi * bj
                    ox += p.x * w
                    oy += p.y * w
                    oz += p.z * w
                end
            end
            outp[i * resolution_j + j + 1] = XYZ(ox, oy, oz)
        end
    end
    return outp
end

function bezier_gpu_kernel(inp, outp, ni::Int32, nj::Int32, resolution_i::Int32, resolution_j::Int32)
    i = (blockIdx().x - Int32(1)) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x - Int32(1)
    if i >= resolution_i
        return
    end

    mui = Float32(i) / Float32(resolution_i - Int32(1))
    for j in Int32(0):(resolution_j - Int32(1))
        muj = Float32(j) / Float32(resolution_j - Int32(1))
        ox = Float32(0)
        oy = Float32(0)
        oz = Float32(0)
        for ki in Int32(0):ni
            bi = bezier_blend(Int(ki), mui, Int(ni))
            for kj in Int32(0):nj
                bj = bezier_blend(Int(kj), muj, Int(nj))
                p = @inbounds inp[ki * (nj + Int32(1)) + kj + Int32(1)]
                w = bi * bj
                ox += p.x * w
                oy += p.y * w
                oz += p.z * w
            end
        end
        @inbounds outp[i * resolution_j + j + Int32(1)] = XYZ(ox, oy, oz)
    end
    return
end

function compare_output(gpu_out::Vector{XYZ}, cpu_out::Vector{XYZ})
    sum_delta = 0.0
    sum_ref = 0.0
    @inbounds for idx in eachindex(cpu_out)
        g = gpu_out[idx]
        c = cpu_out[idx]
        sum_delta += abs(Float64(g.x - c.x)) + abs(Float64(g.y - c.y)) + abs(Float64(g.z - c.z))
        sum_ref += abs(Float64(c.x)) + abs(Float64(c.y)) + abs(Float64(c.z))
    end
    l1norm = sum_delta / sum_ref
    if l1norm >= 1e-6
        println("Test failed")
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

function main(args)
    params = parse_args(args)
    params === nothing && return 0

    input = read_input(params.file_name, params.in_size_i, params.in_size_j)

    cpu_start = time_ns()
    cpu_out = bezier_cpu(input, params.in_size_i, params.in_size_j,
                         params.out_size_i, params.out_size_j)
    cpu_ms = (time_ns() - cpu_start) ÷ 1_000_000
    println("host execution time: $cpu_ms ms")

    d_in = CuArray(input)
    d_out = CuArray{XYZ}(undef, params.out_size_i * params.out_size_j)
    threads = params.work_group_size
    blocks = cld(params.out_size_i, threads)

    CUDA.synchronize()
    kernel_start = time_ns()
    @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks bezier_gpu_kernel(
        d_in, d_out, Int32(params.in_size_i), Int32(params.in_size_j),
        Int32(params.out_size_i), Int32(params.out_size_j))
    CUDA.synchronize()
    kernel_ms = (time_ns() - kernel_start) ÷ 1_000_000
    println("kernel execution time: $kernel_ms ms")

    gpu_out = Array(d_out)
    status = compare_output(gpu_out, cpu_out)
    println(status == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
    return status
end

exit(main(ARGS))

    repeats > 0 || error("positive internal repeat count required")
    reset!(); launch!(); CUDA.synchronize()

    for trial in 1:5

        start = time_ns()
        for _ in 1:repeats
            launch!()
        end
        CUDA.synchronize()
        secs = (time_ns()-start)*1e-9/repeats
        got = vec(readback()); ref = vec(expected)
        length(got)==length(ref) || error("output shape mismatch")
        maxabs=0.0; maxrel=0.0; ok=true
        for (x,y) in zip(got,ref)
            a=abs(Float64(x)-Float64(y))
            b=a/max(abs(Float64(y)),atol,1e-300)
            ok &= isfinite(x) && isfinite(y) && a<=atol+rtol*abs(y)
            maxabs=max(maxabs,a); maxrel=max(maxrel,b)
        end
        allok &= ok
        name="output_trial$(trial).bin"
        path=joinpath(get(ENV,"STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR",pwd()),name)
        write(path,got)
        dtype=eltype(got)==Float32 ? "float32" : eltype(got)==Float64 ? "float64" : eltype(got)==Int32 ? "int32" : eltype(got)==Int64 ? "int64" : error("unsupported dtype")

end
end

using CUDA
using Printf

function bilateral_filter_kernel!(input, output, w::Int32, h::Int32,
                                  a_square::Float32, variance_I::Float32,
                                  variance_spatial::Float32, radius::Int32)
    idx0 = (blockIdx().x - Int32(1)) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x - Int32(1)
    idy0 = (blockIdx().y - Int32(1)) * blockDim().y + threadIdx().y - Int32(1)
    if idx0 >= w || idy0 >= h
        return
    end

    id = idy0 * w + idx0
    center = input[id + Int32(1)]
    res = Float32(0)
    normalization = Float32(0)

    oi = -radius
    while oi <= radius
        oj = -radius
        while oj <= radius
            idk = idx0 + oi
            idl = idy0 + oj
            if idk < 0
                idk = -idk
            end
            if idl < 0
                idl = -idl
            end
            if idk > w - Int32(1)
                idk = w - Int32(1) - oi
            end
            if idl > h - Int32(1)
                idl = h - Int32(1) - oj
            end

            id_w = idl * w + idk
            I_w = input[id_w + Int32(1)]
            range = -((center - I_w) * (center - I_w)) / (Float32(2) * variance_I)
            spatial = -(Float32((idk - idx0) * (idk - idx0) + (idl - idy0) * (idl - idy0))) /
                      (Float32(2) * variance_spatial)
            weight = a_square * exp(spatial + range)
            normalization += weight
            res += I_w * weight
            oj += Int32(1)
        end
        oi += Int32(1)
    end
    output[id + Int32(1)] = res / normalization
    return
end

function reference!(input, output, w::Int, h::Int, a_square::Float32,
                    variance_I::Float32, variance_spatial::Float32, radius::Int)
    for idx0 in 0:w-1, idy0 in 0:h-1
        id = idy0 * w + idx0 + 1
        center = input[id]
        res = Float32(0)
        normalization = Float32(0)
        for oi in -radius:radius, oj in -radius:radius
            idk = idx0 + oi
            idl = idy0 + oj
            if idk < 0
                idk = -idk
            end
            if idl < 0
                idl = -idl
            end
            if idk > w - 1
                idk = w - 1 - oi
            end
            if idl > h - 1
                idl = h - 1 - oj
            end
            id_w = idl * w + idk + 1
            I_w = input[id_w]
            range = -((center - I_w) * (center - I_w)) / (Float32(2) * variance_I)
            spatial = -(Float32((idk - idx0)^2 + (idl - idy0)^2)) / (Float32(2) * variance_spatial)
            weight = a_square * exp(spatial + range)
            normalization += weight
            res += I_w * weight
        end
        output[id] = res / normalization
    end
    return output
end

function c_rand_mod(n::Int)
    return Int(ccall(:rand, Cint, ())) % n
end

function run_radius!(d_src, d_dst, h_src, h_dst, r_dst, w::Int, h::Int,
                     a_square::Float32, variance_I::Float32,
                     variance_spatial::Float32, repeat::Int, radius::Int)
    threads = (16, 16)
    blocks = (cld(w, 16), cld(h, 16))
    CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns()
    for _ in 1:repeat
        @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks bilateral_filter_kernel!(
            d_src, d_dst, Int32(w), Int32(h), a_square, variance_I,
            variance_spatial, Int32(radius))
    end
    CUDA.synchronize()
    elapsed_ns = time_ns() - t0
    @printf("Average kernel execution time (%dx%d) %f (ms)\n",
            radius, radius, (elapsed_ns * 1e-6) / repeat)

    copyto!(h_dst, d_dst)
    reference!(h_src, r_dst, w, h, a_square, variance_I, variance_spatial, radius)
    ok = true
    for i in eachindex(h_dst)
        if abs(r_dst[i] - h_dst[i]) > 1f-3
            ok = false
            break
        end
    end
    return ok
end

function main()
    if length(ARGS) != 5
        println("Usage: main.jl <image width> <image height> <intensity> <spatial> <repeat>")
        exit(1)
    end
    w = parse(Int, ARGS[1])
    h = parse(Int, ARGS[2])
    variance_I = Float32(parse(Float64, ARGS[3]))
    variance_spatial = Float32(parse(Float64, ARGS[4]))
    repeat = parse(Int, ARGS[5])
    img_size = w * h
    a_square = Float32(0.5) / (variance_I * Float32(pi))

    ccall(:srand, Cvoid, (Cuint,), Cuint(123))
    h_src = Vector{Float32}(undef, img_size)
    for i in eachindex(h_src)
        h_src[i] = Float32(c_rand_mod(256))
    end
    h_dst = Vector{Float32}(undef, img_size)
    r_dst = Vector{Float32}(undef, img_size)
    d_src = CuArray(h_src)
    d_dst = CuArray{Float32}(undef, img_size)

    ok = true
    ok &= run_radius!(d_src, d_dst, h_src, h_dst, r_dst, w, h, a_square,
                      variance_I, variance_spatial, repeat, 3)
    ok &= run_radius!(d_src, d_dst, h_src, h_dst, r_dst, w, h, a_square,
                      variance_I, variance_spatial, repeat, 6)
    ok &= run_radius!(d_src, d_dst, h_src, h_dst, r_dst, w, h, a_square,
                      variance_I, variance_spatial, repeat, 9)
    println(ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
    ok || exit(1)
end

    normalization = Float32(0)

        oj = -radius
        while oj <= radius
            idk = idx0 + oi
            idl = idy0 + oj
            if idk < 0

            end
            if idl < 0

            end
            if idk > w - Int32(1)

            end
            if idl > h - Int32(1)

using StaticArrays
@inline function match_lane!(g,img,stacks,counts)
 gx=(g-1)%64;gy=(g-1)÷64;px=gx*3;py=gy*3
 if 105<=px<107;px=104;end
 if 33<=py<35;py=32;end
 if px<105&&py<33
  best=MVector{15,UInt32}(ntuple(_->typemax(UInt32),Val(15)));found=0;base=(gx÷32)*96
  for dy in max(-19,-py):min(19,32-py),dx in max(-19,-base):min(19,104-px)
   if !(dx==0&&dy==0)
    diff=UInt32(0)
    for y in 0:7,x in 0:7
     a=Int32(@inbounds img[px+x+(py+y)*112+1]);b=Int32(@inbounds img[px+dx+x+(py+dy+y)*112+1]);d=a-b;diff+=UInt32(d*d)
    end
    if diff<UInt32(160000)
     key=((diff>>2)<<16)|(UInt32(dy&255)<<8)|UInt32(dx&255)
     if key<best[15]
      j=15
      while j>1&&key<best[j-1];best[j]=best[j-1];j-=1;end
      best[j]=key
     end
     found=min(found+1,15)
    end
   end
  end
  for z in 1:found;@inbounds stacks[(g-1)*15+z]=UInt16(best[z]&UInt32(65535));end
  depth=1;while depth*2<=found+1;depth*=2;end
  @inbounds counts[g]=UInt32(depth-1)
 end
 nothing
end
@inline function origin(g)
 x=((g-1)%64)*3;y=((g-1)÷64)*3
 if 105<=x<107;x=104;end
 if 33<=y<35;y=32;end

end
@inline function offset(stacks,g,z)
 if z==0;return (0,0);end
 v=@inbounds stacks[(g-1)*15+z];x=Int(v&UInt16(255));y=Int(v>>8);(x>=128 ? x-256 : x,y>=128 ? y-256 : y)
end
@inline function gather_lane!(t,img,stacks,counts,group)
 g=(t-1)÷64+1;l=(t-1)%64;x=l%8;y=l÷8;px,py=origin(g)
 if px<105&&py<33
  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1
  for z in 0:n-1
   dx,dy=offset(stacks,g,z);@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+z*64+l+1]=Float32(img[px+dx+x+(py+dy+y)*112+1])
  end
 end
 nothing
end

@inline function transform_lane!(tile,group,inverse)
 base=(tile-1)*64
 for y in 0:7
  v=ntuple(j->(@inbounds group[base+y*8+j]),Val(8));w=inverse ? idctvec(v) : dctvec(v)
  for x in 1:8;@inbounds group[base+y*8+x]=w[x];end
 end
 for x in 0:7
  v=ntuple(j->(@inbounds group[base+(j-1)*8+x+1]),Val(8));w=inverse ? idctvec(v) : dctvec(v)
  for y in 1:8;@inbounds group[base+(y-1)*8+x+1]=w[y];end
 end
 nothing
end
@inline function hard_lane!(g,group,counts,weights)
 px,py=origin(g)
 if px<105&&py<33
  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;nonzero=0;threshold=2.7f0*sqrt(Float32(n*625));v=MVector{16,Float32}(ntuple(_->0f0,Val(16)))
  for l in 0:63
   for z in 1:n;v[z]=@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+(z-1)*64+l+1];end
   step=1
   while step<n
    for j in 1:2*step:n,k in 0:step-1;a=v[j+k];b=v[j+k+step];v[j+k]=a+b;v[j+k+step]=a-b;end
    step*=2
   end
   for z in 1:n
    if abs(v[z])<threshold;v[z]=0f0;else;nonzero+=1;end
   end
   step=1
   while step<n
    for j in 1:2*step:n,k in 0:step-1;a=v[j+k];b=v[j+k+step];v[j+k]=a+b;v[j+k+step]=a-b;end
    step*=2
   end
   for z in 1:n;@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+(z-1)*64+l+1]=v[z]/Float32(n);end
  end
  @inbounds weights[g]=1f0/Float32(max(nonzero,1))
 end
 nothing
end
@inline function aggregate_lane!(t,group,stacks,counts,weights,win,num,den)
 g=(t-1)÷64+1;l=(t-1)%64;px,py=origin(g)
 if px<105&&py<33
  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;wp=@inbounds weights[g];window=@inbounds win[l+1]
  for z in 0:n-1
   dx,dy=offset(stacks,g,z);i=px+dx+l%8+(py+dy+l÷8)*112+1;v=@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+z*64+l+1]
   model_atomic!(num,i,(v*window)*wp);model_atomic!(den,i,window*wp)
  end
 end
 nothing
end
@inline function final_lane!(i,num,den,out)
 @inbounds out[i]=UInt8(clamp(round(Int32,num[i]/den[i]),Int32(0),Int32(255)));nothing
end

 if 105<=px<107;px=104;end

  best=MVector{15,UInt32}(ntuple(_->typemax(UInt32),Val(15)));found=0;base=(gx÷32)*96
  for dy in max(-19,-py):min(19,32-py),dx in max(-19,-base):min(19,104-px)
   if !(dx==0&&dy==0)
    diff=UInt32(0)
    for y in 0:7,x in 0:7
     a=Int32(@inbounds img[px+x+(py+y)*112+1]);b=Int32(@inbounds img[px+dx+x+(py+dy+y)*112+1]);d=a-b;diff+=UInt32(d*d)

@inline function match_lane!(g,img,stacks,counts)
 gx=(g-1)%64;gy=(g-1)÷64;px=gx*3;py=gy*3
 if 105<=px<107;px=104;end
 if 33<=py<35;py=32;end
 if px<105&&py<33
  best=MVector{15,UInt32}(ntuple(_->typemax(UInt32),Val(15)));found=0;base=(gx÷32)*96
  for dy in max(-19,-py):min(19,32-py),dx in max(-19,-base):min(19,104-px)
   if !(dx==0&&dy==0)
    diff=UInt32(0)
    for y in 0:7,x in 0:7
     a=Int32(@inbounds img[px+x+(py+y)*112+1]);b=Int32(@inbounds img[px+dx+x+(py+dy+y)*112+1]);d=a-b;diff+=UInt32(d*d)
    end
    if diff<UInt32(160000)
     key=((diff>>2)<<16)|(UInt32(dy&255)<<8)|UInt32(dx&255)
     if key<best[15]
      j=15
      while j>1&&key<best[j-1];best[j]=best[j-1];j-=1;end
      best[j]=key
     end
     found=min(found+1,15)
    end
   end
  end
  for z in 1:found;@inbounds stacks[(g-1)*15+z]=UInt16(best[z]&UInt32(65535));end
  depth=1;while depth*2<=found+1;depth*=2;end
  @inbounds counts[g]=UInt32(depth-1)
 end
 nothing
end
@inline function origin(g)

end
@inline function offset(stacks,g,z)

end

@inline function transform_lane!(tile,group,inverse)
 base=(tile-1)*64
 for y in 0:7
  v=ntuple(j->(@inbounds group[base+y*8+j]),Val(8));w=inverse ? idctvec(v) : dctvec(v)
  for x in 1:8;@inbounds group[base+y*8+x]=w[x];end
 end
 for x in 0:7
  v=ntuple(j->(@inbounds group[base+(j-1)*8+x+1]),Val(8));w=inverse ? idctvec(v) : dctvec(v)
  for y in 1:8;@inbounds group[base+(y-1)*8+x+1]=w[y];end
 end

end
@inline function hard_lane!(g,group,counts,weights)
 px,py=origin(g)
 if px<105&&py<33
  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;nonzero=0;threshold=2.7f0*sqrt(Float32(n*625));v=MVector{16,Float32}(ntuple(_->0f0,Val(16)))
  for l in 0:63
   for z in 1:n;v[z]=@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+(z-1)*64+l+1];end
   step=1
   while step<n
    for j in 1:2*step:n,k in 0:step-1;a=v[j+k];b=v[j+k+step];v[j+k]=a+b;v[j+k+step]=a-b;end
    step*=2
   end
   for z in 1:n
    if abs(v[z])<threshold;v[z]=0f0;else;nonzero+=1;end
   end
   step=1
   while step<n
    for j in 1:2*step:n,k in 0:step-1;a=v[j+k];b=v[j+k+step];v[j+k]=a+b;v[j+k+step]=a-b;end
    step*=2
   end
   for z in 1:n;@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+(z-1)*64+l+1]=v[z]/Float32(n);end
  end
  @inbounds weights[g]=1f0/Float32(max(nonzero,1))
 end
 nothing
end
@inline function aggregate_lane!(t,group,stacks,counts,weights,win,num,den)
 g=(t-1)÷64+1;l=(t-1)%64;px,py=origin(g)
 if px<105&&py<33
  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;wp=@inbounds weights[g];window=@inbounds win[l+1]
  for z in 0:n-1
   dx,dy=offset(stacks,g,z);i=px+dx+l%8+(py+dy+l÷8)*112+1;v=@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+z*64+l+1]
   model_atomic!(num,i,(v*window)*wp);model_atomic!(den,i,window*wp)
  end
 end
 nothing
end
@inline function final_lane!(i,num,den,out)
 @inbounds out[i]=UInt8(clamp(round(Int32,num[i]/den[i]),Int32(0),Int32(255)));nothing
end

@inline function match_lane!(g,img,stacks,counts)
 gx=(g-1)%64;gy=(g-1)÷64;px=gx*3;py=gy*3
 if 105<=px<107;px=104;end
 if 33<=py<35;py=32;end
 if px<105&&py<33
  best=MVector{15,UInt32}(ntuple(_->typemax(UInt32),Val(15)));found=0;base=(gx÷32)*96
  for dy in max(-19,-py):min(19,32-py),dx in max(-19,-base):min(19,104-px)
   if !(dx==0&&dy==0)
    diff=UInt32(0)
    for y in 0:7,x in 0:7
     a=Int32(@inbounds img[px+x+(py+y)*112+1]);b=Int32(@inbounds img[px+dx+x+(py+dy+y)*112+1]);d=a-b;diff+=UInt32(d*d)
    end
    if diff<UInt32(160000)
     key=((diff>>2)<<16)|(UInt32(dy&255)<<8)|UInt32(dx&255)
     if key<best[15]
      j=15
      while j>1&&key<best[j-1];best[j]=best[j-1];j-=1;end
      best[j]=key
     end
     found=min(found+1,15)
    end
   end
  end
  for z in 1:found;@inbounds stacks[(g-1)*15+z]=UInt16(best[z]&UInt32(65535));end
  depth=1;while depth*2<=found+1;depth*=2;end
  @inbounds counts[g]=UInt32(depth-1)
 end
 nothing
end

@inline function hard_lane!(g,group,counts,weights)
 px,py=origin(g)
 if px<105&&py<33
  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;nonzero=0;threshold=2.7f0*sqrt(Float32(n*625));v=MVector{16,Float32}(ntuple(_->0f0,Val(16)))
  for l in 0:63
   for z in 1:n;v[z]=@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+(z-1)*64+l+1];end
   step=1
   while step<n
    for j in 1:2*step:n,k in 0:step-1;a=v[j+k];b=v[j+k+step];v[j+k]=a+b;v[j+k+step]=a-b;end
    step*=2
   end

   end

   while step<n

end

  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;nonzero=0;threshold=2.7f0*sqrt(Float32(n*625));v=MVector{16,Float32}(ntuple(_->0f0,Val(16)))

 if 105<=px<107;px=104;end
 if 33<=py<35;py=32;end
 if px<105&&py<33
  best=MVector{15,UInt32}(ntuple(_->typemax(UInt32),Val(15)));found=0;base=(gx÷32)*96
  for dy in max(-19,-py):min(19,32-py),dx in max(-19,-base):min(19,104-px)

    diff=UInt32(0)
    for y in 0:7,x in 0:7
     a=Int32(@inbounds img[px+x+(py+y)*112+1]);b=Int32(@inbounds img[px+dx+x+(py+dy+y)*112+1]);d=a-b;diff+=UInt32(d*d)
    end
    if diff<UInt32(160000)
     key=((diff>>2)<<16)|(UInt32(dy&255)<<8)|UInt32(dx&255)

      j=15

using CUDA, Printf
"""Five in-process synchronized host-clock trials, JIT warmed before trial 1.
The same timed launch loop and reset/output boundaries apply to all models.
Full-array CPU checks are outside timing; raw outputs enable dual comparisons.
"""
function run_trials!(launch!, reset!, readback, expected, repeats; atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
    repeats > 0 || error("positive internal repeat count required")
    reset!(); launch!(); CUDA.synchronize()
    allok = true
    for trial in 1:5
        reset!(); CUDA.synchronize()
        start = time_ns()
        for _ in 1:repeats
            launch!()
        end
        CUDA.synchronize()
        secs = (time_ns()-start)*1e-9/repeats
        got = vec(readback()); ref = vec(expected)
        length(got)==length(ref) || error("output shape mismatch")
        maxabs=0.0; maxrel=0.0; ok=true
        for (x,y) in zip(got,ref)
            a=abs(Float64(x)-Float64(y))
            b=a/max(abs(Float64(y)),atol,1e-300)
            ok &= isfinite(x) && isfinite(y) && a<=atol+rtol*abs(y)
            maxabs=max(maxabs,a); maxrel=max(maxrel,b)
